summary: Implemented `in` membership in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ checks node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs, so _RDFNamespace inherits it. Changed ClosedNamespace._ipython_key_completions_ to dir(self.uri) per the spec's wording (switch to list(self.__uris) if term names were intended). Added tests to NamespacePrefixTest in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self, RDFS positive/negative plus Literal and plain-string negatives, RDF rdf:type positive, and rdf:_1 negative; added imports for RDF, RDFS, Namespace, Literal. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and doctests are unverified. No commits made.
